summary: Configuration as Code playbook RBAC_settings.yml (part 1): with vars from vars/all.yml it creates an organization, a team and a user with ansible.platform.organization, team and user, passing aap_hostname, aap_username, aap_password and aap_validate_certs.
questions: How do I create AAP organizations with Ansible?
How do I create a user with ansible.platform?
What is configuration as code for AAP?
